title: VLA-Rolling: Fewer Denoising Steps, Better Control via Adaptive Action Reuse
abstract: arXiv:2610.25043v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models generate an action chunk by iteratively denoising Gaussian noise, but typically execute only a short prefix before replanning with updated observations. Under this receding-horizon paradigm, the unexecuted remainder---the action tail---is discarded, and the next chunk is regenerated from fresh noise. We show that this discarded tail retains transferable denoising progress: action-tail initialization can match or outperform a native 10-step Gaussian baseline using fewer denoising steps. However, the optimal denoising budget varies substantially across samples, indicating that tail reuse should be adapted to the updated environment. Based on this observation, we introduce VLA-Rolling, a lightweight inference framework that reuses action tails through three stages: action-tail inheritance, per-action confidence estimation, and confidence-guided refinement through renoising and denoising

translated_title: VLA-Rolling：更少的去噪步骤、更好的控制——基于自适应动作复用
translated_abstract: 流匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过迭代去噪高斯噪声来生成动作块，但通常只执行其中较短的前缀部分，随后基于更新的观测重新规划。在这种滚动时域范式下，未执行的部分——即动作尾部——被直接丢弃，下一个动作块则从全新噪声重新生成。我们证明，这些被丢弃的动作尾部保留了可迁移的去噪进度：使用动作尾部进行初始化，能够以更少的去噪步骤达到甚至超越原生10步高斯基线的性能。然而，最优去噪预算在不同样本之间差异显著，这表明尾部复用应根据更新后的环境进行自适应调整。基于这一观察，我们提出了VLA-Rolling——一个轻量级推理框架，通过三个阶段复用动作尾部：动作尾部继承、逐动作置信度估计，以及通过再噪化和去噪实现的置信度引导细化。
tldr: 提出轻量级推理框架VLA-Rolling，通过动作尾部继承、置信度估计和置信度引导的再噪化-去噪细化三阶段自适应复用被丢弃的动作尾部，以更少的去噪步骤实现更好的控制性能。
en_tdlr: VLA-Rolling is a lightweight inference framework that adaptively reuses discarded action tails through three stages—action-tail inheritance, per-action confidence estimation, and confidence-guided renoising-denoising refinement—achieving better control with fewer denoising steps in flow-matching VLA models.
